title: ToolLayer Deployment Snapshot
description: The immutable set of exact connector versions one runtime deployment may serve. A snapshot is never edited; a change produces a new snapshot with a new revision and a new digest.

snapshot_id.description: Opaque snapshot identity derived from the snapshot content digest.

revision.description: Monotonically increasing per deployment. Revisions are never reused.

snapshot_digest.description: SHA-256 over the canonical JSON of this document with snapshot_id, snapshot_digest and signature removed. It identifies the content and detects accidental corruption or an edit made without updating the digest. It does NOT authenticate the producer: computing SHA-256 requires no secret, so an attacker who can rewrite the payload can also recompute this value. Producer authenticity comes from the signature field.

signature.description: Detached producer signature over the canonical JSON of this document with the signature field removed — which therefore covers snapshot_id and snapshot_digest as well as every connector. A consumer verifies it against a public key it was configured with out of band. Absent only in an explicitly unsigned local demonstration.

algorithm.description: The only algorithm this contract version defines. An unrecognized value is refused rather than negotiated.

key_id.description: Identifies which trusted public key verifies this signature, so keys can be rotated without a simultaneous redeployment.

connectors.description: Exactly one published version per connector_key. Uniqueness is enforced semantically.
